criteria.text: A capacity forecast names the cluster that runs out first, and when, from the customer's own usage
criteria.how: Collect a month of usage and compare the forecast with the team's own estimate

criteria.text: A routine task the team does by hand runs as an automated runbook, with approval and a log
criteria.how: Automate the most frequent manual task end to end and read its log

criteria.text: A team orders a standard environment from a catalog and gets it within the agreed time, inside its quota
criteria.how: Publish one catalog item with a quota and time a request from a real team

criteria.text: Last month's cost is allocated to teams on a cost per machine agreed with finance
criteria.how: Build the cost model with finance and allocate one month

criteria.text: A baseline check finds a real drift, and security accepts the report
criteria.how: Run the baseline across the estate and review the findings with security

criteria.text: An unusual slowdown raises an alert before the application owner notices
criteria.how: Load a test machine until it slows and see who is told first

readiness: The sites and clusters in scope, with read access for the management plane
A month of usage data, or the time to collect it
Three frequent requests chosen to become catalog items, with their owners
Finance agrees the cost elements: hardware, licences, power, space, people
The security baseline to check against, chosen by security
A test team willing to order through the catalog
